title: EE60070: Fluidic Instrumentation And Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Mechanical Compensators: Circuit analogy, Gears, Gyroscopes. Fluid Power
System: Fluid flow equation. Laminar, turbulent flow. Resistance, capacitance,
inertance. Electrical analogy. Liquid level systems. Pneumatic systems
dynamics. Fluid power components: Pumps, Motors, Valves. Nonlinearities in
valves. Dynamic analysis. Fluid logic systems using valves. Amplifiers.
Hydraulic servo motor. Standard symbols. Fluid
control systems: Valve
positions. Servo.
Hydraulic, Electrical feedback. Valve-motor position
servo.
Tachometer feedback.
Lag
lead
networks
using
mechanicalhydraulic components. Pneumatic nozzle flapper system. Pneumatic relay.
Pneumatic controllers. Fluidics: Coanda effect. Jet interaction fludic
devices. Vortex valves. Impact. Modulator. Turbulance amplifier. Fludic
logic systems.Industrial fluid circuits: Safety circuits. Circuit design. case
studies.
